title: Pagination loop is off by one — returns pageSize + 1 items and overlaps adjacent pages
description: Loop iterates pageSize + 1 times using `i <= startIndex + pageSize`. Causes duplicate items at page boundaries (e.g., paginate(['a','b','c','d','e'], 1, 2) returns 3 items instead of 2, with 'c' appearing in both page 1 and page 2). Page boundary items duplicated across pages; items.length never matches advertised pageSize. Fix: use const items = data.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize).
